---
title: "Pittsburgh Weather PCA"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(openmeteo)
library(arrow)
library(paletteer)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(tidyclust)

options(scipen = 999, digits = 4)

theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

location <- "Pittsburgh, PA"

weather_data <- weather_history(
  location = location,
  start = "1980-01-01",
  end = "2026-09-10",
  daily = weather_variables()$daily_history_vars
) |>
  mutate(location = location, .before = 1)

write_parquet(
  weather_data,
  "posts/pittsburgh_weather_pca/post_data/weather_data.parquet"
)
```

```{r}
weather_data <- read_parquet(
  "posts/pittsburgh_weather_pca/post_data/weather_data.parquet"
)
```

```{r}
glimpse(weather_data)

weather_data |>
  summarize(start = min(date), end = max(date))
```

```{r}
drop_bad_cols <- function(x) {
  bad_cols <- x |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "column_name",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    summarize(is_constant = n_distinct(value) == 1, .by = column_name) |>
    filter(is_constant == TRUE) |>
    distinct(column_name) |>
    pull(column_name)

  print(str_c("dropping ", str_c(bad_cols, collapse = ", ")))

  x <- select(x, -all_of(bad_cols))
}
```

```{r}
pca_fit <- weather_data |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  select(-daily_weather_code) |>
  drop_bad_cols() |>
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca <- pca_fit |>
  augment(weather_data) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^.fittedPC", "pc_")) |>
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE))

pca_values <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues")

pca_values |>
  ggplot(aes(PC, percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:nrow(pca_values)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca |>
  ggplot(aes(pc_1, pc_2, color = month)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = .1) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("jcolors::pal12") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
  coord_fixed()

weather_data_pca |>
  ggplot(aes(pc_1, pc_3, color = month)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = .1) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("jcolors::pal12") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
  coord_fixed()

weather_data_pca |>
  ggplot(aes(pc_2, pc_3, color = month)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = .1) +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("jcolors::pal12") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
  coord_fixed()

weather_data_pca |>
  select(month, pc_1:pc_10) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(month, pc_1)) |>
  mutate(name = fct_inorder(name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(pc_1, value, color = month)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .1, size = .5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scales = "free") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1)))
```

```{r}
# define arrow style for plotting
arrow_style <- arrow(
  angle = 20,
  ends = "first",
  type = "closed",
  length = grid::unit(8, "pt")
)

pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "rotation") |>
  group_by(PC) |>
  slice_max(abs(value), n = 5) |>
  filter(PC %in% c(1:5)) |>
  view()

# plot rotation matrix
pca_rot <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "rotation") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "PC", names_prefix = "PC", values_from = "value")

pca_rot |>
  distinct(column)

graph_pca_rot <- function(pca_df, x, y) {
  pca_df |>
    mutate(text = str_replace_all(column, "_", " ") |> str_wrap(16)) |>
    ggplot(aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]])) +
    geom_segment(xend = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow_style) +
    geom_label(
      aes(label = text),
      size = 2
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2))
}

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("PC1", "PC2")

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("PC1", "PC3")

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("PC1", "PC4")
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca_time <- weather_data_pca |>
  select(date, starts_with("pc_")) |>
  mutate(
    decade = year(date) %/% 10,
    decade = str_c(decade, "0's"),
    year = year(date),
    yday = yday(date)
  )

quantile_df <- function(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) {
  tibble(
    val = quantile(x, probs, na.rm = TRUE),
    quant = probs
  )
}

historical_range <- weather_data_pca_time |>
  filter(year(date) < 2000) |>
  select(date, yday, pc_1:pc_5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc_")) |>
  reframe(quantile_df(value), .by = c(yday, name)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = quant, values_from = val, names_prefix = "pct_") |>
  arrange(name, yday)

historical_range

weather_data_pca_time |>
  select(date, decade, pc_1:pc_5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc_")) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(vars(decade), ncol = 1, scales = "free_x")
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca_time |>
  select(yday, year, decade, pc_1:pc_5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc_")) |>
  ggplot(aes(yday, value, group = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = historical_range,
    aes(x = yday, ymin = pct_0.25, ymax = pct_0.75),
    alpha = .3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = decade, color = decade), lwd = .5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Decadal PC value vs. 1980-2000 historical range (25-65 percentile)",
    x = "Day of year",
    y = "PCA value",
    color = "Decade"
  )
```

```{r}
weather_data_pca_time |>
  select(yday, year, pc_1:pc_5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc_")) |>
  ggplot(aes(yday, value)) +
  geom_smooth(color = "black") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")
```

### Clustering


```{r}
glimpse(weather_data_pca_time)

hc_spec <- hier_clust(
  num_clusters = 4,
  linkage_method = "ward.D2"
)

hc_fit <- hc_spec |>
  fit(
    ~.,
    data = weather_data_pca_time |>
      filter(date < "2026-01-01") |>
      select(starts_with("pc_"))
  )

hc_fit |>
  summary()

hc_fit$fit |> plot()
```


```{r}
cluster_assignments <- weather_data_pca_time |>
  filter(date < "2026-01-01") |>
  bind_cols(extract_cluster_assignment(hc_fit))

cluster_assignments |>
  distinct(.cluster)

seasons <- c("Winter", "Rainy??", "Spring/Fall", "Summer")

cluster_labels <- tibble(
  .cluster = c(str_c("Cluster", 1:4, sep = "_") |> factor()),
  .cluster_label = factor(
    seasons,
    levels = seasons
  )
)

cluster_assignments <- left_join(cluster_assignments, cluster_labels)

levels(cluster_assignments$.cluster)

levels(cluster_assignments$cluster_label)

cluster_pal_test <- scales::hue_pal()(4)

show_col(cluster_pal_test)

cluster_pal_test

cluster_labels

cluster_pal <- c(
  "Winter" = "#00BFC4",
  "Rainy??" = "#C77CFF",
  "Summer" = "#F8766D",
  "Spring/Fall" = "#7CAE00"
)

show_col(cluster_pal)

cluster_assignments |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yday, y = year, fill = .cluster_label)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0)) +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = expansion(0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_pal)

cluster_assignments |>
  filter(decade == "2020's") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yday, y = year, fill = .cluster_label)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0)) +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = expansion(0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_pal)
```

```{r}
cluster_summary <- cluster_assignments |>
  summarize(
    avg_start = mean(min(yday)),
    avg_end = mean(max(yday)),
    days = n(),
    .by = c(.cluster, year)
  ) |>
  left_join(cluster_labels)

cluster_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = days, fill = .cluster_label)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_pal)

cluster_summary |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.cluster, .cluster_label, year)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = .cluster_label)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_pal)
```

```{r}
cluster_centroids <- extract_centroids(hc_fit) |>
  left_join(cluster_labels)

cluster_assignments |>
  ggplot(aes(pc_1, pc_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = .cluster), alpha = .1) +
  geom_label(
    data = cluster_centroids,
    aes(label = .cluster_label, fill = .cluster_label)
  )
```
